tokens.name: color.map.area.label.bg
tokens.usage: Radius pill on the play-area circle (“2 km”). Cobalt 500 in both themes so white text keeps 5.9:1.

tokens.name: color.map.area.label.lip
tokens.usage: 2 dp lip under the radius pill.

tokens.name: color.map.area.label.text
tokens.usage: Radius pill text (numeric.sm, tabular).

tokens.name: color.map.mask
tokens.usage: Veil over the map outside the round's play area, at opacity.mask; outside streets stay readable as context.

tokens.name: color.map.reticle
tokens.usage: Dashed target ring at the map centre before the first pin is dropped (first-run hint). Cobalt = you.

tokens.name: color.map.attribution.bg
tokens.usage: Map attribution chip (© OpenStreetMap contributors, © CARTO), on every map screen.

tokens.name: color.map.attribution.text
tokens.usage: Attribution text in label.sm; 5.2:1 (light) and 10.8:1 (dark) on its chip.

tokens.name: color.map.region.outline

tokens.name: color.map.region.label.bg
tokens.usage: Name chip of an unpicked district on the area picker map (label.md). A picked district's chip uses color.map.area.label.*.

tokens.name: color.map.region.label.text
tokens.usage: Text on an unpicked district's name chip.

tokens.name: color.map.district.locked.fill
tokens.usage: Locked district fill, with 45° hatch in map.district.locked.stroke.

tokens.name: color.map.district.locked.stroke
tokens.usage: Locked district outline and hatch.

tokens.name: color.map.district.progress.fill
tokens.usage: District in progress.

tokens.name: color.map.district.progress.stroke
tokens.usage: In-progress district outline, 3 dp.

tokens.name: color.map.district.mastered.fill
tokens.usage: Mastered district: the city fills with your colour.

tokens.name: color.map.district.mastered.stroke
tokens.usage: Mastered district outline, 3 dp.

tokens.name: color.map.route.line
tokens.usage: Correct route in route drills (same paint as the answer street).

tokens.name: color.map.route.casing
tokens.usage: Casing under map.route.line.

tokens.name: color.map.route.arrow
tokens.usage: Direction chevrons on map.route.line, every 80 dp.

shadow.note: Flat surfaces carry a solid bottom lip (see elevation and the *.lip colours). The single soft shadow is reserved for elements floating over the map.

tokens.name: shadow.none

tokens.name: stroke.base

tokens.name: stroke.thick

tokens.name: stroke.icon
tokens.usage: Stroked parts of icons at 24 dp (scale with icon size).

tokens.name: elevation.0
tokens.usage: Flat: pressed buttons, inline content.

tokens.usage: Lip under chips, segmented controls, list groups.

tokens.name: elevation.2

tokens.name: elevation.3
tokens.usage: Lip under hero buttons and the current path stop.

elevation.note: Elevation is a solid bottom lip in the matching *.lip colour, not a blur. Pressing removes the lip and moves the face down by the same amount.
